tasks.First Removal and Repainting: On Saturday morning, the neighbors took back one third of the flamingos, painted them white, and put these newly painted white flamingos back out on Sue's front yard.
tasks.Initial Placement: On Friday morning, the neighbors placed 18 pink plastic flamingos out on Sue's front yard.
tasks.Second Addition: Then, on Sunday morning, they added another 18 pink plastic flamingos to the collection.
